definition.business_question: Quels appartements sont loues, a qui, depuis quelle date et par quel bailleur ?

projection_contract.business_question: Quels appartements sont loues, a qui, depuis quelle date et par quel bailleur ?

columns.description: Inclusive start of the lease at the explicit as_of date
Inclusive end; an absent end date means open-ended under this contract
Source lease attributes. landlord_id is the declared source identifier, not an inferred owner. Missing landlord_id makes the result indeterminate.
Outgoing declared relations with evidence IDs and endpoint records; unit and household declarations can be incomplete.

assumptions: Only native records in the bound workspace and ontology are covered; import completeness outside this dataset is unknown.
Active means validFrom <= as_of and validTo absent or >= as_of. Cancelled, terminated and inactive leases are excluded. Missing/invalid dates or unknown status are indeterminate.
A declared lease-to-unit link and landlord_id are required. Ownership is not silently equated with the lessor. This fixture contains incomplete landlord declarations.

definition.business_question: Quels lots actifs n'ont pas de proprietaire declare ?

projection_contract.business_question: Quels lots actifs n'ont pas de proprietaire declare ?
paraphrases: Quels appartements n’ont aucun propriétaire renseigné ?
liste des lots sans propriétaire déclaré

columns.description: Lot name within the imported population
No date-valid incoming owns declaration from a person or organization in the same ontology
Declared lot attributes; evidence comes from the native source entity

assumptions: The imported unit population is the demo active-lot population; this contract cannot establish real-world absence of an owner.
Only date-valid owns relations with source type person or organization count as ownership declarations. These are the explicit concrete source types bound to the ontology Agent role.
Missing relations express missing declarations within this dataset, not proof that a property has no legal owner.

definition.business_question: Les quotites de chaque immeuble totalisent-elles 1000 ?

projection_contract.business_question: Les quotites de chaque immeuble totalisent-elles 1000 ?
paraphrases: Dans quels immeubles la somme des millièmes est-elle incorrecte ?

columns.description: Count of distinct directly contained units
Sum of declared unit tantiemes; missing numeric evidence yields null
Declared building quota_basis; the demo uses 1000
1 when abs(total - expected) < 0.000001, 0 when it differs, null when indeterminate
Native unit IDs contributing to this building total, within the bound ontology

assumptions: The raw contains predicate is explicitly bound to building_contains_unit for building-to-unit endpoints. Other contains relations are excluded.
Duplicate relationships do not count a lot twice. A building without units or with nonnumeric/missing quota evidence is indeterminate.
The imported population defines dataset coverage. These totals do not establish completeness of a real-world property register.
Member quota_basis must agree with the building basis, which must equal the declared contract value 1000; mismatches are indeterminate.
